_note: ⛔ SNG-438. SKILL COVERAGE AUDIT — Erik: 'my spec isn't comprehensive, it was a start. Think critically about it and any other RPG games. What does a PC need to be able to do? Can each type of character do those things with their primary domain at about 75% minimum, and a secondary adjacent domain to cover 100%? Map the skills to primary stats. My characters tend to flirt and woo — are there skills to help with that?'
_headline:
⛔ THE FLIRT TEST RETURNS ZERO. Searched all 376 for flirt/woo/charm/seduce/allure/attract/desire/romance/courtship/beguile: NOT ONE ABILITY. ⚠️ INTIMIDATE RETURNS ZERO BY NAME TOO — the effect exists (The Dread, The Weight of Presence) but nothing is authored AS intimidation.
⛔ THE 136 SOCIAL ABILITIES ARE ALL AUTHORITY, ORDER, TRUTH AND FEAR. Not one is warmth, attraction, seduction, or intimacy. A player who plays a charmer has NOTHING to reach for, and Erik plays charmers.

attributeBalance._finding: ⛔ MENTAL IS 3.6× PHYSICAL. An even split would be 94 each. ⚠️ THE GAME IS AUTHORED BY PREFERENCE — the traditions that think have three times the options of the traditions that act, and PHYSICAL at 12% means a body-first character is starved across the whole corpus.
attributeBalance._erikRules: the target split. Even quarters is one answer; another is that mental SHOULD lead in a world about reaches of mind — but not 3.6×.

traditionAttributeGaps._finding:
⛔ 27 OF 31 TRADITIONS HAVE AT LEAST ONE COMPLETELY EMPTY ATTRIBUTE. Only valley_craft, rootkin, mason and wright cover all four.
⚠️ SIX HAVE THREE EMPTY: hourkeeper, figurist, syllogist, cogitant (all mental-only), god_named and bargainers (social-only). ⛔ A COGITANT HAS 11 MENTAL ABILITIES AND ZERO PHYSICAL, SOCIAL OR PRACTICAL — they cannot pick a lock, throw a punch, or charm anyone using their own tradition.

pcNeedsCoverage._finding:
⛔ MEAN PRIMARY-DOMAIN COVERAGE IS 68%, AGAINST ERIK'S 75% BAR. Only 12 of 31 traditions reach 75%; four sit at 40%.
⚠️ CONCEAL IS MISSING FROM 28 OF 31 — it is not a gap, it is an unauthored function. Only the Veilwrights and Umbrals can hide, which may be intended, but it means every other character is visible always.
⛔ SOCIAL IS MISSING FROM 13 TRADITIONS, which compounds the flirt gap: not only is there no charm ability anywhere, most traditions have no social ability at all.

proposals.A_theMissingSocialSpace: ⛔ AUTHOR THE ATTRACTION/INTIMACY SPACE — it is a whole missing quadrant, not a few skills. ⚠️ AND IT MUST BE TRADITION-SHAPED, not a generic 'Charm': a Threnodist woos by shared feeling, an Abyssal by naming the want, a Verist by unbearable honesty, a Veilwright by being exactly who you wanted to meet, a Somatic by presence. ⛔ THAT IS FIVE GENUINELY DIFFERENT SKILLS AND THEY WRITE THEMSELVES FROM THE TRADITIONS ALREADY AUTHORED.
proposals.B_intimidation: ⚠️ The effect exists unlabelled. Either tag the existing ones (The Dread, The Weight of Presence, The Blazing Word) or author per-tradition versions as with A.
proposals.C_physicalStarvation: ⛔ PHYSICAL AT 12% NEEDS A DELIBERATE PASS. Grapple, climb, leap, endure, carry, hold-your-breath, break-down-a-door — the ordinary physical verbs are largely absent, and they are what a body-first PC reaches for.
proposals.D_theSecondaryDomainRULE: ⚠️ ERIK'S 75%+SECONDARY MODEL IS SOUND AND THE CORPUS DOES NOT MEET IT. ⛔ BEFORE AUTHORING, THE ADJACENCY MAP MUST BE RULED: which tradition is 'adjacent' to which? The reaches suggest pole-pairs (umbral/blazeborn share dark_light), but a player picking their OPPOSITE pole as secondary is a different game than picking a neighbour. THIS IS ERIK'S CALL and everything else waits on it.

_whatIWillNotDo: ⛔ I am not authoring 50 abilities off my own judgement. The attribute target, the adjacency map, and whether CONCEAL should be universal are all system decisions. ⚠️ Give me those three rulings and the authoring is mechanical.
